accepted.s:
Under the three-capital proposal of Andhra Pradesh, which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
1. Executive seat — Visakhapatnam
2. Legislative seat — Amaravati
3. Judicial seat — Kurnool
accepted.x: The proposal assigned Visakhapatnam as the executive seat, Amaravati as the legislative seat and Kurnool as the judicial seat.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure seat-city pair and eliminate codes with a swapped location.
accepted.sec: Capital decentralisation debate - three capitals, repeal, Amaravati revival  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
The three-capital proposal of Andhra Pradesh was based primarily on the recommendations or findings of which of the following?
1. G.N. Rao Committee
2. Boston Consulting Group study
3. Sarkaria Commission
accepted.x: The proposal was based on the G.N. Rao Committee and a Boston Consulting Group study. The Sarkaria Commission was not cited as its basis.
accepted.tq: Identify the bodies actually associated with the proposal and reject the unrelated constitutional body.
accepted.sec: Capital decentralisation debate - three capitals, repeal, Amaravati revival  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly represents the South African model cited in the context of Andhra Pradesh’s three-capital proposal?
accepted.x: The model cited assigned administrative functions to Pretoria, legislative functions to Cape Town and judicial functions to Bloemfontein.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between similar capital-function pairs rather than relying on the city names alone.
accepted.sec: Capital decentralisation debate - three capitals, repeal, Amaravati revival  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Andhra Pradesh Government withdrew the three-capital and CRDA-repeal laws in:
accepted.x: Both the three-capital proposal and the CRDA-repeal laws were withdrawn in November 2021.
accepted.tq: Use the close-year trap by distinguishing withdrawal in 2021 from the later High Court decision.
accepted.sec: Capital decentralisation debate - three capitals, repeal, Amaravati revival  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the later developments concerning Amaravati:
1. The Andhra Pradesh High Court upheld Amaravati as the capital in March 2022.
2. The Assembly resolved on 28 March 2026 to seek statutory status for Amaravati.
3. The AP Reorganisation (Amendment) Bill, 2026 made Amaravati the sole and permanent capital with retrospective effect from 2 June 2024.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The High Court decision was in March 2022, the Assembly resolution was on 28 March 2026, and the 2026 amendment provided for Amaravati’s sole and permanent-capital status retrospectively from 2 June 2024.
accepted.tq: Track the legal sequence carefully: court decision, Assembly resolution and statutory amendment.
accepted.sec: Capital decentralisation debate - three capitals, repeal, Amaravati revival  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The AP Reorganisation (Amendment) Bill, 2026, relating to Amaravati, was passed by the Lok Sabha on:
accepted.x: The Lok Sabha passed the AP Reorganisation (Amendment) Bill, 2026 on 1 April 2026. It subsequently received Presidential assent.
accepted.tq: Separate the date of the Assembly resolution from the date of parliamentary passage.
accepted.sec: Capital decentralisation debate - three capitals, repeal, Amaravati revival  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The headquarters of the Andhra Pradesh Capital Region Development Authority is located at:
accepted.x: The headquarters of APCRDA is at Rayapudi.
accepted.tq: Test the exact institutional location against nearby Amaravati-region places.
accepted.sec: Amaravati capital region - APCRDA, foundation, land pooling, master plan, funding  [APPSC]

accepted.s: APCRDA was established under which legislation?
accepted.x: The Andhra Pradesh Capital Region Development Authority was established under the APCRDA Act, 2014.
accepted.tq: Use the legislation-name trap by distinguishing the specific APCRDA Act from broader state and Union laws.
accepted.sec: Amaravati capital region - APCRDA, foundation, land pooling, master plan, funding  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The capital city area of Amaravati comprises approximately:
accepted.x: The capital city area is stated as 217 square kilometres spread across 29 villages.
accepted.tq: Match the area figure with its corresponding number of villages and reject figures belonging to the wider region or other estimates.
accepted.sec: Amaravati capital region - APCRDA, foundation, land pooling, master plan, funding  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The wider Amaravati capital region covers approximately:
accepted.x: The wider capital region is stated to cover 8,352.69 square kilometres.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the wider regional area from the much smaller capital-city area.
accepted.sec: Amaravati capital region - APCRDA, foundation, land pooling, master plan, funding  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Who laid the foundation stone for Amaravati at Uddandarayunipalem on 22 October 2015?
accepted.x: The Prime Minister of India laid the foundation stone at Uddandarayunipalem in Guntur on 22 October 2015.
accepted.tq: Combine the event, date and location while applying the authority-who-did-it trap.
accepted.sec: Amaravati capital region - APCRDA, foundation, land pooling, master plan, funding  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
1. Restart Amaravati project office — April 2025
2. Relaunch of Amaravati project — 2 May 2025
3. Foundation stone at Uddandarayunipalem — 22 October 2015
accepted.x: The project office opened in April 2025, the project was relaunched on 2 May 2025, and the foundation stone was laid on 22 October 2015.
accepted.tq: Arrange the event dates mentally and verify each date-location or date-event pairing.
accepted.sec: Amaravati capital region - APCRDA, foundation, land pooling, master plan, funding  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Under Phase I of the Amaravati Land Pooling Scheme, what percentage of the targeted 37,921 acres was pooled?
accepted.x: Phase I achieved pooling of 93.1% of 37,921 acres.
accepted.tq: Use the precise percentage trap rather than approximating the land-pooling achievement.
accepted.sec: Amaravati capital region - APCRDA, foundation, land pooling, master plan, funding  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly states the Phase I land-pooling outcome in Amaravati?
o: 70,550 returnable plots were allotted after pooling 93.1% of 37,921 acres
16,666 returnable plots were allotted in seven villages
37,921 returnable plots were allotted from 70,550 acres
70,550 acres were pooled and 37,921 plots were allotted
accepted.x: Phase I pooled 93.1% of 37,921 acres and allotted 70,550 returnable plots.
accepted.tq: Split the options into the correct acreage, percentage and plot figures to catch reversed quantities.
accepted.sec: Amaravati capital region - APCRDA, foundation, land pooling, master plan, funding  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Phase II of the Amaravati Land Pooling Scheme was notified for approximately:
accepted.x: Phase II was notified for about 16,666 acres in seven villages.
accepted.tq: Distinguish Phase II’s area and village count from the Phase I figures.
accepted.sec: Amaravati capital region - APCRDA, foundation, land pooling, master plan, funding  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about rehabilitation and support under the Amaravati land-pooling process:
1. Farmers received ₹2,038.61 crore in annuity.
2. Pensions are being received by 17,601 landless labourers.
3. The annuity was paid to landless labourers, while pensions were paid to farmers.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Farmers received ₹2,038.61 crore in annuity and 17,601 landless labourers received pensions. Statement 3 reverses the beneficiaries.
accepted.tq: Catch the reversed-beneficiary trap by matching each financial support with its recipient group.
accepted.sec: Amaravati capital region - APCRDA, foundation, land pooling, master plan, funding  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The master plan for Amaravati was prepared by:
o: Boston Consulting Group of the United States
accepted.x: Surbana Jurong of Singapore prepared the Amaravati master plan.
accepted.tq: Apply the organisation-function trap by separating the master-plan consultant from lenders and policy consultants.
accepted.sec: Amaravati capital region - APCRDA, foundation, land pooling, master plan, funding  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Amaravati master plan envisages a city that is primarily:
o: A hill city on the Eastern Ghats
A desert-based industrial city on the Godavari
A coastal port city on the Bay of Bengal
A water-centric city on the Krishna
accepted.x: The master plan envisages Amaravati as a water-centric city on the Krishna.
accepted.tq: Translate the planning concept into its geographical setting and reject reversed river-location options.
accepted.sec: Amaravati capital region - APCRDA, foundation, land pooling, master plan, funding  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following lender-amount pairs relating to Amaravati is correctly matched?
1. World Bank and ADB — ₹15,000 crore
2. HUDCO — ₹11,000 crore
3. NaBFID — ₹7,500 crore
4. NABARD under NIDA — ₹7,387.70 crore
accepted.x: All four lender-amount pairs are correctly matched. World Bank and ADB provided ₹15,000 crore on concessional terms, HUDCO ₹11,000 crore, NaBFID ₹7,500 crore and NABARD under NIDA ₹7,387.70 crore.
accepted.tq: Start with a sure lender-amount pair and check that no amount has been shifted to another institution.
accepted.sec: Amaravati capital region - APCRDA, foundation, land pooling, master plan, funding  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The World Bank and ADB assistance for Phase I of Amaravati was described as:
accepted.x: The World Bank and ADB were associated with ₹15,000 crore of concessional assistance for Phase I.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the amount and character of finance from the facilities associated with other lenders.
accepted.sec: Amaravati capital region - APCRDA, foundation, land pooling, master plan, funding  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding Amaravati works:
1. Ninety-six works worth ₹57,592.71 crore were sanctioned.
2. Physical progress was reported at 6.84% in SES 2025–26.
3. ₹426.46 crore was sanctioned for trunk infrastructure in the Undavalli zone in June 2026.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements correctly state the sanctioned works, physical progress and Undavalli trunk-infrastructure sanction.
accepted.tq: Check the figures and dates independently instead of treating the large project amount as the only tested detail.
accepted.sec: Amaravati capital region - APCRDA, foundation, land pooling, master plan, funding  [APPSC]

accepted.s: In Swachh Survekshan 2022, Visakhapatnam received the designation of:
o: Cleanest City in the small-town category
Top Impact Creator in the million-plus category
Safaimitra Suraksha Champion in the below-million category
accepted.x: Visakhapatnam was recognised as the Top Impact Creator in the million-plus city category in Swachh Survekshan 2022.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between the award title and the category instead of selecting a generic cleanliness label.
accepted.sec: Urban rankings and awards - Swachh Survekshan, Ease of Living, Municipal Performance Index  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which municipal corporation of Andhra Pradesh ranked first in the Safaimitra Suraksha category of Swachh Survekshan 2022?
accepted.x: Tirupati Municipal Corporation ranked first in the Safaimitra Suraksha category.
accepted.tq: Separate the Safaimitra Suraksha result from Visakhapatnam’s different Top Impact Creator award.
accepted.sec: Urban rankings and awards - Swachh Survekshan, Ease of Living, Municipal Performance Index  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Swachh Survekshan 2024 rankings were used to select how many ULBs for sanitation Project Management Units?
accepted.x: The Swachh Survekshan 2024 rankings were used to choose 46 ULBs for sanitation PMUs.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the selected ULB count from the total number of ULBs and municipal categories in the State.
accepted.sec: Urban rankings and awards - Swachh Survekshan, Ease of Living, Municipal Performance Index  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which statement correctly compares the urbanisation level of Andhra Pradesh with that of India in 2011?
o: Andhra Pradesh had a lower urban share of 22.87%, while India had 29.47%.
Andhra Pradesh had a lower urban share, 29.47%, than India’s 31.16%.
Andhra Pradesh had a higher urban share, 40.81%, than India’s 31.16%.
Both had the same urban share of 29.47%.
accepted.x: In 2011, Andhra Pradesh had an urban share of 29.47%, below India’s 31.16%.
accepted.tq: Watch for the reversed-comparison trap involving the State and national percentages.
accepted.sec: Urbanisation data - urban share, districts below average, agglomerations, Census 2011  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following pairs of old districts and their 2011 urbanisation percentages is correctly matched?
1. Visakhapatnam — 47.45%
2. Krishna — 40.81%
3. Srikakulam — 16.16%
4. Prakasam — 19.56%
accepted.x: All four district-percentage pairs are correct for the former 13-district configuration of Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Match each district with its exact percentage before evaluating the coded combination.
accepted.sec: Urbanisation data - urban share, districts below average, agglomerations, Census 2011  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following districts were less urbanised in 2011 than India was in 1991?
1. Srikakulam
2. Vizianagaram
3. West Godavari
4. Visakhapatnam
accepted.x: Srikakulam, Vizianagaram and West Godavari were below India’s 1991 urbanisation level of 22.87%. Visakhapatnam was not included in this group.
accepted.tq: Use the benchmark comparison with 22.87% and identify the districts below it.
accepted.sec: Urbanisation data - urban share, districts below average, agglomerations, Census 2011  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Under the 28-district configuration, which district had the highest and which had the lowest urban share respectively?
accepted.x: Visakhapatnam had an urban share of 89.69%, while Polavaram had 2.84% under the 28-district configuration.
accepted.tq: Separate the post-reorganisation percentages from the old 13-district figures.
accepted.sec: Urbanisation data - urban share, districts below average, agglomerations, Census 2011  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The urban population of Andhra Pradesh was 173.5 lakh and was projected to reach what level by 2029?
accepted.x: The urban population was stated as 173.5 lakh, with a projection of 190.9 lakh by 2029.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the current urban population from the projected figure and reject numerically similar distractors.
accepted.sec: Urbanisation data - urban share, districts below average, agglomerations, Census 2011  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following cities were selected as Andhra Pradesh’s four Smart Cities?
accepted.x: The four Smart Cities in Andhra Pradesh are Visakhapatnam, Kakinada, Tirupati and Amaravati.
accepted.tq: Test the complete State list and reject substitutions of other important Andhra Pradesh cities.
accepted.sec: Smart Cities Mission in AP - selected cities

accepted.s: Delivery under the Smart Cities Mission is primarily through:
o: State finance commissions without any SPV
Area-based and pan-city projects through a 50:50 SPV
accepted.x: The Mission uses area-based and pan-city projects delivered through a 50:50 Special Purpose Vehicle arrangement.
accepted.tq: Apply the implementation-design concept and reject options that remove either the project approach or the SPV.
accepted.sec: Smart Cities Mission in AP - selected cities

accepted.s: Which of the following Andhra Pradesh Smart Cities reported progress on works funded under the Mission’s extension in April 2026?
accepted.x: Visakhapatnam, Kakinada and Tirupati reported progress on extension-funded works in April 2026.
accepted.tq: Use the extension-period city list and avoid replacing a selected city with a prominent non-listed city.
accepted.sec: Smart Cities Mission in AP - selected cities

accepted.s: Which of the following is associated with Visakhapatnam’s Smart City projects?
o: A judicial capital complex and land-pooling office
Integrated command centre and intelligent traffic system
Only rural irrigation tanks and canals
accepted.x: Visakhapatnam’s Smart City projects include an integrated command centre and an intelligent traffic system.
accepted.tq: Match the project feature to the correct city rather than the broader Mission objective.
accepted.sec: Smart Cities Mission in AP - selected cities

accepted.s: Which scheme is primarily concerned with water supply, sewerage and rejuvenation of water bodies?
accepted.x: AMRUT and AMRUT 2.0 focus on water supply, sewerage and water bodies.
accepted.tq: Use the objective-based distinction between urban services, housing and plotted development schemes.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes in AP - objective

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about AMRUT in Andhra Pradesh:
1. AMRUT 1.0 involved 174 projects worth ₹3,362.68 crore.
2. AMRUT 2.0 involved 506 projects worth ₹9,514.63 crore.
3. The target completion date for AMRUT 2.0 is December 2027.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements correctly state the project counts, financial values and target date for AMRUT and AMRUT 2.0 in Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Verify each programme generation against its project count, amount and deadline.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes in AP - objective

accepted.s: PMAY-Urban 2.0 in Andhra Pradesh is mainly intended to provide:
accepted.x: PMAY-Urban 2.0 is a housing scheme intended to provide pucca houses.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a housing objective from the water, land-pooling and ranking functions of other programmes.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes in AP - objective

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the PMAY-Urban 2.0 approvals mentioned for Andhra Pradesh?
o: 61,084 houses with ₹882.32 crore central aid, plus 12,370 houses for 107 ULBs
12,370 houses with ₹4,451 crore aid, plus 61,084 flats in 30 layouts
2.61 lakh houses with ₹603.20 crore aid, plus 11,894 plots
61,084 ULBs with ₹882.32 crore aid, plus 12,370 plots in 107 villages
accepted.x: PMAY-Urban 2.0 approved 61,084 houses with ₹882.32 crore in central aid, along with 12,370 additional houses for 107 ULBs on 17 June 2026.
accepted.tq: Separate houses, ULBs, plots and flats to catch the swapped-unit trap.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes in AP - objective

accepted.s:
APTIDCO housing is associated with which of the following?
1. PMAY-U 1.0 flats
2. A HUDCO loan of ₹4,451 crore to complete 2.61 lakh houses
3. TIDCO Livelihood Centres
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: APTIDCO housing covers PMAY-U 1.0 flats, the HUDCO loan for completing 2.61 lakh houses and TIDCO Livelihood Centres.
accepted.tq: Link the housing agency with its flats, financing and livelihood components instead of treating it as a single-purpose scheme.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes in AP - objective

accepted.s: YSR Jagananna Colonies provide:
o: Commercial plots for Smart City SPVs
Pensions exclusively to landless labourers in Amaravati
House sites and houses for poor women under Navaratnalu-Pedalandariki Illu
accepted.x: YSR Jagananna Colonies provide house sites and houses for poor women under the Navaratnalu-Pedalandariki Illu programme.
accepted.tq: Identify the scheme objective and beneficiary group while rejecting objectives belonging to other programmes.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes in AP - objective

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched with NTR Smart Townships?
accepted.x: NTR Smart Townships comprise 30 layouts and 11,894 plots, with an amount of ₹603.20 crore.
accepted.tq: Match the scheme with its distinctive layout, plot and financial figures rather than borrowing figures from other schemes.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes in AP - objective

accepted.s: Andhra Pradesh has how many Urban Local Bodies, and what is their composition?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh has 123 ULBs comprising 17 corporations, 76 municipalities and 30 nagar panchayats.
accepted.tq: Check both the total and its component counts to detect reversed or altered composition.
accepted.sec: Urban schemes in AP - objective

accepted.s: Which of the following authority-city pairs is NOT correctly matched?
accepted.x: Godavari UDA is associated with Kakinada-Rajamahendravaram, not Visakhapatnam. VMRDA is the authority for Visakhapatnam.
accepted.tq: Find the one swapped city-authority pair by checking the regional jurisdiction of each authority.
accepted.sec: Urban development authorities - city
